verifiedAgainst.note: Verified, and it corrected a plausible wrong answer: `.clinerules` is a DIRECTORY at the project root, not a single file. Cline processes all .md and .txt files inside it and combines them into one rule set. Global rules live in the OS Cline Rules directory (Documents/Cline/Rules). Cline also reads AGENTS.md at the project root and ~/.agents/AGENTS.md as the cross-tool standard format; workspace rules take precedence over global rules, and the docs do not state AGENTS.md's precedence relative to the others.
